title: Exosome isolation from serum using ExoQuick reagent
protocol: Transfer 500 μL of serum into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 125 μL of ExoQuick Exosome Precipitation Solution to the serum.
Incubate the mixture for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge the ExoQuick/serum mixture at 1,500 × g for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down residual ExoQuick solution by centrifugation at 1,500 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove all traces of fluid by aspiration, taking care not to disturb the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL sterile PBS.
Proceed with RNA isolation using SeraMir Exosome RNA Purification Column Kit.
